verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms docs.openwebui.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a curated machine-readable index of all docs pages, exactly matching the llms.txt convention for pointing agents at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: no independent/community confirmation that agents actually consume it successfully, and no additional agent-oriented doc formats (e.g. openapi.json 404s) to complement llms.txt.
